S02.name: 灯笼鱼
S02.form: a slender elongated body, a large head, a large eye, a terminal mouth, cycloid scales, a complete lateral line
S02.fins: a dorsal fin, a small adipose fin, a forked tail fin
S02.markings: rows of round photophores along the belly and flanks

S03.name: 鼬鳚
S03.form: an elongated eel-like body, a tapering tail, a small head, a blunt snout, small eyes, a terminal mouth, small cycloid scales, a complete lateral line
S03.fins: a long dorsal fin, a long anal fin, the dorsal and anal fins joined continuously to the tail fin, pelvic fins set far forward under the throat

S04.name: 银斧鱼
S04.form: a deep laterally compressed body, a thin hatchet-shaped body, a short head, a steep forehead, large tubular upward-directed eyes, a small mouth
S04.fins: a dorsal fin, an anal fin, small pectoral fins, a forked tail fin
S04.markings: rows of photophores along the belly

S05.name: 帆蜥鱼
S05.form: a slender elongated body, a ribbon-shaped body, a large head, a large mouth, a deep mouth cleft, large canine teeth, a short snout
S05.fins: a long high sail-like dorsal fin, a medium-sized adipose fin, an anal fin at the rear of the body, low pectoral fins with elongated spear-shaped front rays, small pelvic fins, a deeply forked tail fin with the upper lobe drawn out into filaments
S05.colour: 头部及体背部蓝青色，体侧和腹部银灰色，具有珍珠光泽

S07.name: 管眼鱼
S07.form: a small rounded body, a transparent dome-like head, tubular eyes, upward-directed eyes that can rotate

S09.name: 黑叉齿鱼
S09.form: an elongated slender body, a large head, a very large mouth, sharp recurved teeth, naked skin with no scales, small eyes, a long tapering tail
S09.fins: a long dorsal fin, a long anal fin, small pectoral fins, a forked tail fin

S10.name: 尖牙鱼
S10.form: a large ridged head, a body tapering sharply from behind the head to the caudal peduncle, small eyes, a large mouth, sharp teeth, rough skin, overlapping scale rows along the lateral line
S10.fins: a dorsal fin with no spines and 17 to 20 soft rays, an anal fin with no spines and 7 to 9 soft rays
S10.colour: 成体深棕至黑色；幼体浅灰色，腹部有暗色鳞片构成的黑斑
